description: Queueable findings from the last index: unused exports, duplicate implementations (two files exporting the exact same name), and wrapper functions (a function whose whole body is one call to another export). Excludes findings the user has muted, unless includeMuted is set. Pass one straight to queue_finding to fix it — never invent or paraphrase its fields.

limit.description: Maximum items to return (default 50, max 500). The response reports totalCount and truncated so you can tell whether you saw everything.

title: List findings
